description: Use this when the user asks how popular a baby name is or was, its rank or number of babies in a year, its trend, peak year, or wants to compare up to 5 names (e.g. "how popular is Olivia", "Emma vs Ava since 1990", "what rank was Jennifer in 1975"). Returns US Social Security birth counts per year 1880-2025, SSA ranks (top 1,000 for past years; listed names in 2025), peak year, highest rank, 10-year change, girls/boys split and other spellings, with a chart. US data only. Does not give name meanings or origins.

names.description: 1 to 5 first names to look up or compare, e.g. ["Olivia", "Charlotte"]. Add (girl) or (boy) to pick a sex per name, e.g. "Avery (boy)". Accents are ignored for lookup (Zoë finds Zoe).

sex.description: Sex for all names, e.g. girl. Default any: each name uses the sex with more US births in 2016-2025.

year.description: Optional single year to report births and rank for, e.g. 1990.

name: find_name_trend
title: Find name popularity trend
